notes.title: Survival Edition is here!
notes.content:
Implemented different levels of difficulty for puzzles: Easy / Medium / Hard
 Implemented a new system for bite attacks from enemies
 Added daggers to defense against enemies
 Improved graphics with better textures and a new lighting quality for high-end computers
 Changes in cameras to improve visual experience
 Changes in levels to improve decoration
 Added new playable sequences, more puzzles and new clues
 Added new cinematics for storytelling
 Improved AI of the enemies
 Improved player aiming system
 Better optimization for low-end computers
 Added new sounds and voices for enemies
